origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends; its tool names, its generation settings with a dynamic thinking budget, the functionCall and functionResponse parts with the ids of the gateway), model gemini-2.5-pro: the relay refuses its own key (401) and the tier below has no account in service, so the client is told that no account is available (a relay's 401 is never what the client is told: D5). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
